description: An API Gateway built on Spring Framework and Spring Boot providing routing and more.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.9.16 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4266
* Fix forwarded headers for untrusted proxies by @Manihass-Ch in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4271
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.2 to 3.2.0-rc.3 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4273
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.2 to 3.2.0-rc.3 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4264
* Filter out synthetic and anonymous types when registering hints by @ryanjbaxter in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4277
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.3 to 3.2.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4281
* Bump antora from 3.2.0-rc.3 to 3.2.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4280
* Document how default filters and route filters are ordered by @gohri81-tech in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4289
* Reactor core retry caching by @spencergibb in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4290
* Move from spring-boot-starter-web to spring-boot-starter-webmvc by @ryanjbaxter in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4293
* Dispose upstream connection when a cancelled exchange discards the response in `NettyRoutingFilter` by @raccoonback in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4283
* Update Antora UI bundle to v0.4.26 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4295
* Update Antora UI bundle to v0.4.26 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4296
* Allow Dependabot minor version updates on main by @ryanjbaxter in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4298
* Bump org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-jar-plugin from 3.4.2 to 3.5.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4301
* Bump bucket4j.version from 8.15.0 to 8.20.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4300
* Bump com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java-util from 4.33.6 to 4.36.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4302
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.10.0 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4304
* Update Maven wrapper to 3.10.0 by @spring-builds in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4303
* Bump grpc.version from 1.77.1 to 1.84.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4299
* Bump antora from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4312

* Bump @antora/atlas-extension from 1.0.0-alpha.5 to 1.0.0-alpha.6 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/spring-cloud/spring-cloud-gateway/pull/4311
